text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (Well, I bought what I needed, but...)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(A sample set, huh— ...Don't need it. 
Guess I'll just pawn it off on someone.)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh, why, why...!? I'm sure I came out of 
Exit 3...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez, this is a completely different 
place!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... I'm getting hungry, and I just 
want to go home already~~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you kid over there. Screaming your 
head off on the roadside is completely 
disgraceful.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Sirius!! Thank goodness~~~...! Hey, 
guess what, there's something I wanna ask—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Wha-aat?! What are you doing all of a 
sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Is this an assortment of Toughness 
Bars?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's the perfect present for a kid, right? 
Take it and be grateful.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh, I can have it!? Yaay! I was so 
hungry~~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but—quit calling me a "kid" all the 
time!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah, easily pleased by food. What a bunch 
of brats.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Walking outside after finishing work, I 
saw Sirius Symboli and Tokai Teio walking 
together.
choice_data_list: (This is kind of... an unusual sight?)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Is that Sirius's Trainer over there? 
Yoo-hoo!
choice_data_list: Have you two been hanging out together?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Why would I bother doing something that 
annoying? This guy just tagged along on 
his own.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~, when I got lost, Sirius came over 
and gave me a present~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I was so happy that I tagged along! 
Sirius is really kind deep down, isn't 
she?♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understand completely how Tokai Teio 
feels. When you're anxious, having someone 
show even a little care makes you 
naturally want to follow them.
choice_data_list: If you need a guide, I can help too!
If you need a guide, I can help too!

Gotta make sure she gets safely back to 
the academy.

I need to make sure to walk her all the 
way back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understand completely how Tokai Teio 
feels. When you're anxious, having someone 
show even a little care makes you 
naturally want to follow them.

I need to make sure to walk her all the

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"What's this? You want to come along too? 
Well, I guess I can't say no~♪"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
One more dog doesn't change anything. Do 
whatever you want.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hey! Are you treating me like a dog 
too?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
At least pick something a little tougher! 
Like a tiger, or a lion!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That yappy, noisy attitude of yours is 
exactly why I'm calling you a dog.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez! I told you, I'm not yapping like a 
puppy~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching this heartwarming (?) scene, I 
felt I understood once more why Sirius 
Symboli is so adored by her juniors.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah, I'm under no obligation to go that 
far. Whether you choose to tag along on 
your own is entirely up to you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
At least you can try not to be a pain in 
the neck, you got that, pup?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're so dishonest with yourself~ 
You're actually super happy someone's 
relying on you~~âª

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Oh? You want me to leave you here?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? W-Wait, wait! I was just 
kidding~~~~~~!!

text_block_list.text:

felt I understood once more why Sirius 
Symboli is so adored by her juniors.
